as_is.matching: manual, 1-4 working days after receipt for every invoice
as_is.payment: weekly run on Fridays; 12% of invoices missed in the spreadsheet for one extra week

to_be.matching: automatic, same day for invoices with no exception
to_be.exception_resolution: exception queue with owner, 1-5 working days; 10% are real disputes with the supplier, 10-25 days
to_be.approval_wait: SLA 3 working days with reminder; 85% within 0-3 days, 15% late at 4-9 days
to_be.payment: weekly payment proposal; each invoice paid in the last Friday run on or before its due date
to_be.duplicates: 90% caught by the supplier + invoice-number rule (re-numbered duplicates can still slip through)
